absent_coverage: The initial grid is exploratory and bounded (see experiment.json grid.not_covered); no glitch-immunity envelope is claimed or ratified (DR-003 Sec8). The expansion policy is declared in the manifest.
Edge/slew is varied one-factor-at-a-time around the center point only, not crossed with the full cube.
ll/hh passive skew and mismatch Monte Carlo are not exercised; PTAT/CTAT are open; no post-layout parasitics; default solver settings only.
temp_core startup artifacts of #86 are not presumed fixed: an affected point shows up as an UNRESOLVED baseline, a NONPHYSICAL node or an ERROR, not as a PASS.
The POR_RAW-domain injection class is a separate record; a VDD-level result says nothing about the deglitch dwell in isolation.

class_info.label: VDD-level supply glitch (unmodified assembly)
class_info.purpose: characterise the boundary between 'the dwell visibly rejects' and 'the rail is too low for the block to hold state' (axis 2); DUT netlist spliced byte-identical

definitions.assertion: RESETn falls through V_IL starting from HIGH at t0 (Schmitt).  assertion_rail_limited is recorded when VDD itself was <= V_IL at that instant (the output could not stay high regardless of the comparator).  Release = RESETn rises through V_IH.
definitions.baseline: viable when, before t0: exactly one RESETn release and no re-assert, RESETn >= V_IH and POR_RAW >= V_MID over the 2 ms before t0, delivered bias branch current > 0 with peak-to-peak <= 5 % of its mean. Otherwise UNRESOLVED (detected codes are kept in 'detected_codes_ungraded').
definitions.deck attribution: each point's retrieved input deck must carry this experiment's banner and request tag, the committed XMN1 L=20 W=0.42, no diagnostic marker, the class's injection element exactly when the class is por_raw_inject, and the declared .param line; otherwise ERROR deck_attribution (a point can never be credited to the wrong DUT/class).
definitions.delivered bias: explicit measurement: drain current [id] of bias_core XMPIB (PMOS whose drain IS the IBIAS node), saved by the testbench as .save @m.xdut.xbias.xmpib.msky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5[id] and appearing in the klt waveform as i(@m.xdut.xbias.xmpib.msky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5[id]). Sign: ngspice BSIM4 reports id POSITIVE for normal conduction in both polarities (established by the brownout-top local probe: XMPIB id ~0.78 uA equals the sum of the consumer diode devices' ids), so the delivered branch current is +id and must be positive at baseline (else NONPHYSICAL). The consumer-side diode devices (comparator, output chain, temp_core XMBD [id]) are saved; their sum over the delivered current at the end is recorded. The IBIAS NODE voltage is recorded separately and never used as a current. End/baseline ratio band [0.8, 1.25] else FAIL bias_not_recovered.
definitions.detectability: a dip is 'required-to-assert' when VDD spends >= 50 us below V_MUST (piecewise-linear dwell from the full-resolution VDD).  Dips that are not required may assert or not -- both are recorded, neither fails -- but an assertion must still recover.
definitions.expansion policy: No envelope is claimed. Expansion is a NEW record, never an edit: (a) where a PASS<->FAIL (or reject<->assert) boundary appears between adjacent levels on any axis, add the midpoint level on that axis at the affected corners only; (b) edges faster than 10 us (class A) / slews above 200 kV/s (class B) need a cost estimate first; (c) widths outside 20 us - 2 ms, RINJ between/outside {1k, 30k}, floors between the three levels only with a stated reason; (d) repeated glitches, glitches before the baseline is released, ll/hh passive skew and mismatch Monte Carlo are not in this increment. Any post-hoc addition is labelled as such in its record.
definitions.expectation: Per stimulus, stated in every point: class A from the full-resolution POR_RAW dwell below V_MID -- < 50 us (D_REJ) calls for REJECTION (RESETn must stay above V_IL), >= 1 ms (D_REQ) calls for ASSERTION (must assert, then release), in between assertion is optional but must release; no-injection control calls for no assertion. Class B from the VDD dwell below V_MUST -- >= 50 us (T_REQ) calls for assertion, otherwise optional; rail_collapse (VDD <= V_IL) and dwell_rejection_visible (POR_RAW fell, RESETn did not assert) are recorded. D_REJ/D_REQ are exploratory definitions, not claims about the design's dwell.
definitions.grid: Floors as in brownout-top (2.0 V shallow, 1.2 V below half supply, 0.4 V below V_IL at every starting supply) so the two experiments are comparable; holds 20 us and 200 us are the short-glitch decade that brown-out (>= 10 us at slews 2/50 kV/s) did not isolate; symmetric edges at 50 kV/s (~20-50 us per edge), varied one factor at a time at the center to 20 and 200 kV/s (a 200 kV/s edge to 1.2 V is ~9 us; tmax 1.1 us). Faster edges (1 MV/s class) need tmax <= 50 ns and are a declared expansion.
definitions.levels: V_IL = 0.2 vf, V_IH = 0.8 vf, V_MID = 0.5 vf, V_MUST = 0.5 vf (vf = the point's starting supply)
definitions.observation: 8 ms after the glitch ends (class A: end of the GINJ fall edge; class B: end of the recovery edge, at the largest starting supply): 1.9x the slowest observed release delay (4.3 ms). A shorter record is truncated -> UNRESOLVED unless a failure is already detected.
definitions.physicality: every saved node within [-0.3 V, vf+0.5 V] for t>0, settled supply current -i(BVDD) > 0, delivered bias positive at baseline. Violation -> NONPHYSICAL (cannot PASS; behavioural verdict not graded).
definitions.recovery: VDD recovered when >= 0.98 vf after the recovery edge starts; an assertion beginning later is reassert_after_recovery; two or more assertions are reassert_chatter; RESETn must be >= V_IH over the last 1 ms.
definitions.resolution: max sample gap from t0-10 us to glitch end+100 us must be <= min(20 us, width/5, edge/8) for class A (0.1 % float tolerance) and the brown-out rule min(20 us, hold/5, edge/10) for class B AND the sampled drive (VDD for B, GINJ and VDD for A) must match the declared stimulus (VDD within 20 mV, GINJ within 0.02); class A additionally needs the injection to take POR_RAW below V_MID (else the dwell was not exercised -> UNRESOLVED). Otherwise a point with no detected failure is UNRESOLVED, not PASS.
definitions.stimulus: Common: power-up ramp min(vf, rup*t) from a physical 0 V, then glitch at t0. Class vdd_level: V(VDD) = min(vf, rup*t) - ex*(clip01((t-t0)*s/ex) - clip01((t-t0-ex/s-th)*s/ex)), ex = max(vf - vlow, 0), symmetric slews sf = sr = s, hold th at the floor (the brown-out BVDD source with sf = sr; SPICE twin of brownout_checker.vdd_expected). Class por_raw_inject: V(VDD) = min(vf, rup*t) only; GINJ g(t) = gen*(clip01((t-t0)/te) - clip01((t-t0-te-tw)/te)). Width tw is the FLAT-TOP width; the full pulse is tw + 2te at the base and tw + te at half amplitude. Control: gen = 0 (class A) / vlow = 99 (class B).
definitions.trace storage: committed traces are change-triggered (dV >= 2 mV on VDD/RESETn/POR_RAW/IBIAS node, delivered bias or injection current moved >= 2 % of its maximum, GINJ moved >= 0.01, or a 1 ms anchor); RESETn assertion/release counts are re-derived from the stored trace and compared with the full-resolution result per point.
definitions.verdicts: ERROR (missing waveform / channel / non-finite data / convergence, model or backend error) > NONPHYSICAL > UNRESOLVED (unviable baseline, truncated, sparse, stimulus mismatch) > FAIL (resolved physical failure, with trace evidence) > PASS.  NOT_COVERED marks points whose request was never submitted, was refused by the fleet, or has no report; they are counted as uncovered, never as PASS.

experiment.claim: Issue #117 (child of #106; completes the porting-plan Sec3.5 scope next to brownout-top) -- NOT a spec claim: no ratified numeric glitch envelope exists (DR-003 Sec8) and no gf180mcu number is used. Two glitch classes are stimulated, graded and summarised SEPARATELY on the committed design/netlist/temp_por_top.spice (bias_core + temp_core + por_comparator + por_output_chain, real shared IBIAS node, real RESETn -> temp_core.EN feedback, no ideal bias/sensor substitution, PTAT/CTAT open, committed XMN1 L=20 W=0.42, no retired diagnostic edit): (A) por_raw_inject -- a finite-impedance pulse injected into the POR_RAW node through an instrument element spliced into the DUT subckt, so it is INSTRUMENTED-assembly evidence, not as-drawn; the comparator stays connected and no-injection controls are retained; (B) vdd_level -- a symmetric-edge supply glitch on the UNMODIFIED assembly. Each is run across {tt,ss,ff,sf,fs} x {-40,27,125 C} x {2.97,3.30,3.63 V} starting supplies and graded from full-resolution RESETn/POR_RAW/VDD/IBIAS-node waveforms and the explicit delivered bias branch current (sim/glitch-top/glitch_checker.py). A completed simulation is not a behavioural PASS; failed cells are evidence.
